INSERT INTO task
                  (
                    id,
                    title,
                    body_enc,
                    status,
                    completed_at,
                    priority,
                    due_at,
                    tags,
                    parent_id,
                    project,
                    context_id,
                    is_recurring,
                    created_at,
                    updated_at,
                    kind,
                    source_item_id,
                    sink_item_id,
                    user_id
                  )
                VALUES
                  ($1, $2, $3, $4::task_status, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10, $18, $11, $12, $13, $14::task_kind, $15, $16, $17)
                RETURNING
                  id
